sources.snippet: A local, rank-aware League of Legends matchup assistant. Detects your champ-select pick/ban state automatically and gives instant early/mid/late-game matchup advice through a chat-style interface, backed by a small fine-tuned LLM plus a retrieval layer that stays current with the patch cycle without retraining.

sources.snippet: My work spans machine learning, statistical modeling, fraud detection, and cybersecurity applications. Right now I'm particularly interested in how AI can make security operations more efficient. Outside of data science, I breakdance - there's something satisfying about both finding patterns in datasets and nailing a new move.
